claims.evidence: Photos show the body and box but no way to confirm internal sensor specs or that this unit matches the stated spec.
No power-on or burst-shooting test shown; this is a nominal factory spec, not a tested behavior of this specific unit.
No AF test, live view, or screen display shown to confirm autofocus system is functional.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show both the camera body markings and the retail box clearly labeled 'Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit'.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function (shutter, AF, sensor all untested)
risks.proof: A video clip showing power-on, live view, autofocus engaging, and a test shot displayed on the rear screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count / actual usage history, which affects real value regardless of cosmetic condition
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a diagnostic app or menu screen, or firmware info screen

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, haze, dust) not assessable from current angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements against a light source
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically/optically flawed worst case

risks.risk: No battery, charger, memory card, or strap confirmed as included in the sale
risks.proof: A photo laying out all accessories to be included alongside the camera and lens
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Screen and sensor condition (dead pixels, scratches, dust spots) unknown
risks.proof: A photo of the rear screen powered on, and a test image of a plain white/blue sky to reveal sensor dust spots
risks.if_unproven: priced as having screen/sensor defects, worst case

risks.risk: Physical damage (drops, cracks, mount wear) not visible from the two angles shown
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and lens mount angles, plus close-up of the hot shoe and ports
risks.if_unproven: priced as having undisclosed physical damage

risks.risk: Possible mismatch between the box and the actual body (box could be reused or not original to this unit)
risks.proof: A photo showing the serial number on the body matching the serial number printed on the box
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-original kit / mismatched set

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and a test shot shown on the rear screen
Photo of the shutter count from the camera menu or a diagnostic tool
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements under light
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, memory card, strap)
Photo of serial number on body matching the box
Photos from additional angles: top, bottom, lens mount, and ports
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II kit (body + lens, no accessories confirmed), so it can be priced at worst case for untested function, unknown shutter count, and missing accessories, with a path to a higher price once the listed proofs are provided.
